name: Travel Planner by Gildhart
changelog:
• Posts to share now inform. Each draft still reports the outbreak notice (its day, disease and country) and still leads to the travel consultation; it now also says what UK travel health guidance lists for travellers to that country: the vaccination for the notice's disease, by the disease's name, at the tier that country's own card gives it ("for most travellers", "for some travellers"), and that which vaccinations apply is settled at a consultation. It says so only where the country's card lists that vaccination and the pharmacy gives it, and never for a meningitis notice, which does not say which kind. No draft names a brand, gives a price or an offer, or makes a claim for a vaccine.
  • Travel Planner > Settings > Posts to share chooses how a pharmacy's posts are written: what the guidance lists (the default), or "consultation only", which is 1.6.0's wording and names no vaccination. Its responsible pharmacist decides, and reads each post before it is shared.
  • Contacts. Where a pharmacy offers reminders by email, the form now asks for a first name (the visitor may leave it out) and has a second box of its own, never ticked for anyone: "Also email me travel health news and offers from [the pharmacy]". Those who tick it are kept on Travel Planner > Contacts, with their name, email address, trip, the day they agreed and the words they agreed to; the list downloads as a CSV file for the pharmacy's own email tool. Those who do not are reminded and deleted, as before.
  • Every email the plugin sends someone on the list carries the link that takes them off it. Leaving is that link and the one button on its page: they are off the list at once, the pharmacy is emailed that someone left (never who), and the screen keeps who asked to stop so a copy of the list made earlier can be put right. The confirmation email also has a link that deletes everything, for someone who asked for none of it. WordPress's own Export and Erase Personal Data tools find and erase a person on the list.
  • A link in one of the plugin's emails (cancel the reminder, leave the list, delete everything) now opens a page with one button, and acts only when the button is pressed. Mail services open every link in an email to check it before its reader sees it; in 1.6.0 that alone would have cancelled a reminder.
  • Email only: no phone number is asked for, and nobody on the list has agreed to a text message. The list is on only with reminders by email, and Travel Planner > Settings > Reminders > "Keeping in touch" turns it off; the line for the site's privacy notice is beside it. Travel Planner > Look-ups says how many are on the list, never who.
  • Settings: posts_style (educational or consultation) and remind_keep (on), on the screen and in a site's file.
